notes.title: 👀PROBABLY THE LAST PLAYTEST👀
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Settlers, 👋 [/h3]

[u][b]👀PROBABLY THE LAST PLAYTEST👀[/b][/u]

For the next closed playtest sessions we have a brand new version of Of Life and Land! 🙂 

[b]The latest features are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Numerous UI improvements thanks to your feedback
[*] New building tools for roads, fences and fields
[*] We have added new mechanics and buildings to the game and described the various mechanics more clearly.
[/list]

[b]And this is how you can join the playtest: [/b]
[list]
[*] Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG]https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG[/url]
[*] Sign up for the closed playtest using this link: [url=https://forms.gle/38wDcavUzyEASEkw7]https://forms.gle/38wDcavUzyEASEkw7[/url] - Wait until you are accepted into the playtest.
[*] Play the latest playtest version of  "Of Life and Land".
[*] Complete our survey to let us know how you liked the game.
[/list]

Explore this new version and help us prepare the release. 😉 

[u][b]Your Team Kerzoven 🥰 [/b][/u]

notes.title: 👀 New CLOSED Playtest Sessions
notes.content:
[b]Hey Settlers, 👋 [/b]

[u][b]👀 New CLOSED Playtest Sessions[/b][/u]

For the next closed playtest sessions we have a brand new version of Of Life and Land! 🙂 

[b]The latest features are:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now play up to tier 6 👩‍🌾
[*] If you've been following the Dev Diary channel, you'll have seen the latest buildings that have been added to the new version. 🏘️
[*] It will now take you several hours to complete the game 🕐
[/list]

[b]And this is how you can join the playtest: [/b]
[list]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/BN6ShMhkQB]Discord[/url]. 
[*] Sign up for the closed playtest using this link: [url=https://forms.gle/38wDcavUzyEASEkw7]https://forms.gle/38wDcavUzyEASEkw7[/url] - Wait until you are accepted into the playtest.
[*] Play the latest playtest version of  "Of Life and Land".
[*] Complete our survey to let us know how you liked the game.
[*] BONUS POINTS: Record your play session and send it to us privately.
[/list]

Explore this new version and help make the game even better!

[u][b]Your Team Kerzoven 🥰[/b][/u]
